name: sls_admin
description: A Flutter Web administration portal for **Swiss Luxury Services (SLS)** — private jet charter and VIP concierge services.

scripts.build: flutter build web --release --no-wasm-dry-run && cp web/privacy-policy.html build/web/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp web/privacy.html build/web/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.vercel-build: if [ ! -d "flutter" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 flutter; fi && export PATH="$PATH:$(pwd)/flutter/bin" && flutter doctor && flutter build web --release --no-wasm-dry-run && cp web/privacy-policy.html build/web/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp web/privacy.html build/web/ 2>/dev/null || true
